The only park like that in Johnston is Dewey which has outdated equipment and unkept bathrooms.  The splash pad is not kid friendly.  Look to Waukee or others.  Terra park has a prairie growing around it?!?! Do you know what that means… there is a playground with children in the middle of animals’ habitat. Like snakes. It’s honestly asanine. column136:
PUBLIC POOL- The amount of property taxes we pay to have no access to a city pool is outrageous.  Every other suburb in the metro has found the budget to make this happen for their residents.  The fact that the only outdoor pool in Johnston is a private country club is inequitable and unacceptable.  We are so far behind every other city in the area in regard to amenities and this is long past time to get done.  There is no excuse. 

REC LEAGUES/COURTS - We have to drive to Ankeny, Urbandale, Grimes, West Des Moines, DSM, Waukee, and others to find sand volleyball leagues, slow pitch, kickball, etc.  Johnston offers nothing in this department unless it's aimed towards senior citizens.  

A KID FRIENDLY SPLASH PAD: The "splash pad" has a giant metal structure in the middle of it.  Is that space meant for families and children?  Families were hopeful for the addition of a splash pad and now still have to drive elsewhere to enjoy a kid-friendly splash pad that doesn't look like concrete and metal.  

PARKS & PLAYGROUNDS: The parks in Johnston are severely lacking and, again, parents and caretakers are forced to drive out of Johnston to enjoy interesting parks.  Terra Park is in the middle of "prairie"... Do you know what that means? There is a playground in animals' habitat.  Like snakes. And Foxes.  It is so poorly thought out I'm embarrassed for our city.  Again, families are driving to well-planned parks near water like Raccoon River in WDM.  Other city parks have paths that circle playground so people can enjoy walking or wheeling around while others play.  Johnston parks are the least desirable in the metro.  The only well shaded and well laid out park is Dewey (with a walking trail) and the equipment and bathrooms are not maintained.  The Johnston Commons Park is in the middle of a grass field with NO shade and baby trees.  There was so much potential there, and again, Johnston failed to deliver. 

Johnston has good access to biking trails.  That is all.

Our recreational activities are geared towards senior citizens, and are a direct blow again families, especially the middle class.
column137:
A GYM:  There is NO gym/workout facility in Johnston that offers childcare.  We need a YMCA or similar that offers services to our community and place for exercise and fitness with childcare and child programming.  This should be a top priority for our city.  Johnston is so far behind the development of every other suburb/town in the metro; it is astounding.  There is a Power Life Yoga, Orange Theory and a country club.  This is another direct hit on parents, especially low-income or single parents.  

YOUTH SPORTS:  There is a lack of recreational sports leagues in johnston.  You should not need to pay outrageous money and join a club team for your child to try out sports.  This, again, is not true for any of the other metro cities, and families are forced to drive elsewhere to sign up for rec youth sports.

Is this new giant rec area going to serve our community?  The Rex Plex in West Des Moines is open to families and kids everyday from 9-11 for $1.  Is the city partnering to make this happen for Johnston residents? 

Again, to enjoy quality and diverse, affordable indoor recreational activity you must look outside of Johnston.  I would never recommend Johnston as a community to raise a family until the city starts to prioritize tax dollars to serve the needs and wants of regular families.
